title: klin harness protocol decision, version 1
description: The one JSON object klin prints on stdout in answer to a harness protocol event. The integration translates it back into its own host protocol. klin's exit code carries the same answer: 0 for allow and tell, 2 for deny and block.

action.description: allow: let the call or the stop through. deny: refuse this tool call. block: refuse this stop and put the message in front of the agent. tell: let the stop end and put the message in front of the person.

reason.description: Why the call was refused. A deny carries it.

message.description: The report a block returns, or the note a tell carries.
